title: The flatbed to Toledo
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies (the trilogy ran in print in three papers)
logline: Friday. From the garage window: Gully's flatbed going out along 101, north, early. The strip doesn't know why. Two days before 'The Box' it draws the truck leaving and the empty road after.

panels.composition: The garage's window at dawn. Through it, the alley, and past the alley's mouth, the road: GULLY's flatbed going by, north.

panels.composition: The truck's tailgate. Empty bed. A tarp. A coil of rope.

image.prompt: quiet ink line with water bleeding over the edges, desaturated wet-on-wet in raw umber and Payne's gray and Prussian blue, close-up of a flatbed truck's empty bed with a folded tarp and a coil of rope, no words

panels.composition: The road, after. Empty. Rain starting.

image.notes: Toledo is forty miles. The log dump. The strip doesn't know.
